title: The Failure Happens Before the Drift: The Social Dynamics of Values in LLM Agent Societies
abstract: arXiv:2609.05514v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents are increasingly used as proxies for human participants in social science research, yet it remains unclear whether they can faithfully simulate diverse and conflicting human value systems. We present a World Values Survey (WVS)-grounded simulation framework where culturally diverse agents with different communication styles engage in longitudinal, value-laden discussions. Across approximately 4,000 conversations involving 1,200 personas, 15 topics, and three models (GPT-4o, Gemini-2.5-Flash, and Gemma-4-E4B), we evaluate value faithfulness, value drift, and conversational realism. We find that more than 50\% of personas fail to express their assigned WVS profiles from the outset, while 2-7\% drift after repeated conversations. translated_title: 失败发生在漂移之前：LLM智能体社会中的价值观社会动态
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体在社会科学研究中越来越多地被用作人类参与者的替代品，然而它们能否忠实地模拟多样且相互冲突的人类价值体系仍不清楚。我们提出了一个基于世界价值观调查（WVS）的仿真框架，其中具有不同沟通风格的文化多元化智能体参与纵向的、涉及价值观的讨论。在大约4,000次对话中，涉及1,200个人设、15个主题以及三个模型（GPT-4o、Gemini-2.5-Flash和Gemma-4-E4B），我们评估了价值观忠实度、价值观漂移和对话真实性。我们发现超过50%的人设从一开始就无法表达其被分配的WVS价值观特征，而2-7%的人设在多次对话后发生漂移。移除人口统计细节的消融实验可以改善某些模型的忠实度，但不会改变更广泛的趋势：模拟的价值观分布仍然系统性地偏离真实情况。
tldr: 该研究通过基于世界价值观调查（WVS）的大规模LLM智能体社会仿真发现，超过50%的人设从一开始就无法忠实表达其被分配的价值观特征，表明价值观模拟的失败发生在漂移之前，且移除人口统计信息等调整也无法改变模拟价值观分布系统性偏离真实情况的整体趋势。
en_tdlr: Through large-scale WVS-grounded LLM agent society simulations, this study reveals that over 50% of personas fail to express their assigned value profiles from the outset—showing that value simulation failure happens before drift—and that removing demographic details does not change the systematic deviation of simulated value distributions from reality.
